title: Treatise on the Meridian Cleave of the Falchion
summary: Teaches full-meridian qi flow through the falchion's chop, pairing each cleave with a stepping approach for champions.

title: Canon of Field-Borne Chopping
summary: Shows Xiantian students how to carry the qi field out along the falchion so a chop strikes beyond the steel.

title: Handbook of the Falchion Wall and Answer
summary: Sets out guards of full-meridian qi that blunt a heavy attack and return a chop through the opening.

title: The Wide Field Falchion Treatise
summary: Gathers the broad sweeps and great chops that a Xiantian falchion user makes with the field extended around the blade.

title: The Twin-Track Falchion Treatise
summary: Teaches the dual-track pairing of one qi stream in the legs and one in the blade for heavy falchion work.

title: Paired Hawk Stoop with the Heavy Blade
summary: Gives the hawk-style falchion forms in which a high feint and a stooping chop are always paired.

title: Basin Guard Manual of the Falchion
summary: Teaches the basin guards, which gather a blow in a curve of the blade and let it drain away.

title: Azure Dual-Track Cleaving Rolls
summary: Records the school's paired cleaving forms for Xiantian students, run on two linked tracks of the qi field.

title: Wind-Sworn Falchion Bearings
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn way of taking a bearing on the opponent and letting the heavy blade fall along it.

title: Oath of the Plateau Chop
summary: Sets out the plateau school's oath-bound chops, in which the qi field is held steady as the blade falls.

title: Gale Guard Manual of the Falchion
summary: Teaches guards that turn like a gale around the broad blade, scattering an attack and returning the cut.

title: Treatise of Bearing and Gale for the Falchion
summary: Gives Xiantian students the school's open-ground falchion forms, built on a held bearing and a sudden gale-like turn.
